svg.text: LLM RL Post-Training - Megatron train + vLLM rollout + Data Buffer - vllm-project/vime (built on slime)
L3 - Core Three-Module Architecture (slime design + vLLM backend)
Prompt init + custom dataset + rollout_buffer plugins
Sample storage, filtering, group validation, replay
Connects Megatron train reads and vLLM rollout writes
Actor / Critic updates (PPO, GRPO, DAPO, etc.)
TP / PP / EP / CP full Megatron parallelism
Megatron-HF convert + sync weights to vLLM after step
weight sync: POST /update_weights - IPCWeightTransferEngine (native vLLM, per-model via --vllm-config)
L4 - Native Engine Pass-Through & vLLM Config
slime-style explicit dataflow - vLLM-native rollout and weight sync
Step 0: Load prompts / dataset - init Data Buffer + optional rollout_buffer plugin
Step 1: Rollout - vLLM generate via vllm-router (custom-generate-function optional)
Step 2: Score - custom RM / verifier / rule-based reward / tool feedback
Step 3: Store - write (prompt, response, logprobs, reward) samples to Data Buffer
Step 4: Train - Megatron actor update from buffer batch (MFU monitored)
Step 5: Weight sync - POST /update_weights to vLLM (IPC / per-model config) - loop
First step: Megatron params synced to vLLM before training - resume without HF ckpt update
Colocate: tune --vllm-gpu-memory-utilization (~0.8) - Megatron and vLLM share VRAM
Multi-model serving with per-model routers and selective weight updates
agent loops via vLLM HTTP API
vime = slime train/data design + vLLM inference stack - stable train-infer alignment in vLLM ecosystem
vllm-project/vime - multi-node MoE RL - fully-async - Agentic RL - multi-hardware via vLLM plugins
Init path: Ray cluster - Megatron train workers + vLLM engines + vllm-router - init Data Buffer - load ckpt
Step path: vLLM rollout - reward - buffer store - Megatron train - /update_weights sync - metrics - repeat
Sources: vllm-project/vime - vllm.ai blog 2026-06-09 - docs.vllm.ai/projects/vime - slime/THUDM design lineage
